overview: Welcome to Roof‑ER. Learn our mission, values, leadership, and how we operate as a customer‑first, integrity‑driven team.
learningObjectives: Describe Roof‑ER mission and core values
Understand expectations for professionalism and communication

sections.title: Mission & Values
sections.content: At Roof‑ER, our mission is to hold a fiduciary responsibility to our customers — plain and simple. Core values: Integrity, Quality, Simplicity.

sections.title: Leadership Team
sections.content:
Meet the leadership team below. Click a photo to view a short bio.

[BIOS]

leadershipBios.name: Oliver Brown
leadershipBios.title: Owner & Founder
leadershipBios.bio: Founder of Roof‑ER, focused on fiduciary responsibility and customer‑first principles. 15+ years across roofing operations and leadership.

leadershipBios.name: Reese Samala
leadershipBios.title: General Manager
leadershipBios.bio: Oversees day‑to‑day operations, training, and quality control. Ensures projects meet standards, timelines, and documentation best practices.

leadershipBios.name: Ford Barsi
leadershipBios.title: Director of Sales
leadershipBios.bio: Leads sales enablement and coaching with an ethics‑first approach. Coaches reps on value‑driven conversations and consistent follow‑through.
